tools.name: list_threats
tools.description: Every technique Ohey publishes, with its page, a summary, site counts and its kits.

tools.name: get_threat
tools.description: A technique or kit page's statistics: sites matched by month, how many sites were still infected when rescanned, WordPress and Joomla shares, common plugins and core versions, kits seen together on the same sites, its EtherHiding contracts and the articles about it.

tools.name: list_research_articles
tools.description: Ohey research articles, newest first: incident write-ups with timelines, code analysis and indicators.

tools.name: search_etherhiding_contracts
tools.description: Smart contracts that compromised websites read their next stage from, as the EtherHiding contract tracker lists them: chain, kit, current destinations and when Ohey last read each one. Set destination to find the contracts that point, or pointed, at a host.

tools.name: get_etherhiding_contract
tools.description: One contract's destinations over time, the contracts or endpoints it names next, and when Ohey first and last read it.

tools.name: get_feed_stats
tools.description: The size of the Ohey feed, hosts added, accepted, removed and denied over the last seven days, and the size of Ohey's capture archive.
